description: 保持原79目标，读取已真实定位41原报告，修正HTTP200不等于原正文的身份判断，未定位不替换
executed_source:
import json,hashlib,re,threading
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

base=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_cash_constraint_original_panel_v1')
proto=json.loads((base/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
loc=json.loads((base/'全部79经济期_真实目录定位登记.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
receipts=json.loads((base/'全部66原发布目录实际取得回执.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert not (base/'实际原报告GET账本.jsonl').exists(),'既有原请求账本禁止重跑'
tz=ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')
def now():return datetime.now(tz).isoformat()
def dump(name,data):(base/name).write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
catalog_semantics=[]
for r in receipts:
    s={'page_index':r['page_index'],'raw_receipt':r}
    if r['status']!='OK':s['content_status']='RAW_GET_FAILED_NO_RETRY'
    else:
        raw=Path(r['path']).read_bytes()
        soup=BeautifulSoup(raw.decode('utf-8-sig',errors='replace'),'html.parser')
        articles=[a for a in soup.select('a[href]') if re.search(r'^\./20\d{4}/t\d{8}_\d+\.html$',a['href'])]
        is_challenge='Please enable JavaScript and refresh the page.' in soup.get_text(' ',strip=True)
        s.update(content_status='BROWSER_CHECK_ONLY_NO_ORIGINAL_CATALOG' if is_challenge else ('ORIGINAL_CATALOG_WITH_ARTICLES' if articles else 'NO_ORIGINAL_ARTICLES'),article_anchors=len(articles),original_title=soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True) if soup.title else None)
    catalog_semantics.append(s)
dump('实际66目录内容资格_保留原HTTP统计.json',catalog_semantics)
eligible=[r['candidates'][0] for r in loc if r['locator_status']=='EXACTLY_ONE_ORIGINAL']
assert len(eligible)<=79
assert len({r['url'] for r in eligible})==len(eligible)
dump('原报告请求前真实定位及目录内容状态.json',{'at':now(),'prior_protocol':(base/'protocol.json').as_posix(),'eligible_actual_original_hrefs_count':len(eligible),'targets':eligible,'all_missing_preserved':len(loc)-len(eligible),'http_200_not_equal_original_source':True,'new_queries':0,'raw_GET_retries':0,'finance':'NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN','new_stock_labels':0})
lock=threading.Lock()
ledger=base/'实际原报告GET账本.jsonl'
def trace(record):
    with lock:
        with ledger.open('a',encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n');f.flush()
def fetch(t):
    item={'economic_period':t['economic_period'],'requested_url':t['url'],'catalog_original_title':t['original_title'],'catalog_origins':t['catalog_origins'],'started_at':now(),'attempt':1,'raw_GET_retries':0}
    trace({'event':'REQUEST_STARTED',**item})
    try:
        r=requests.get(t['url'],timeout=(10,30))
        p=base/'sources'/(t['economic_period']+'.html')
        p.write_bytes(r.content)
        soup=BeautifulSoup(r.content.decode('utf-8-sig',errors='replace'),'html.parser')
        full=soup.get_text('\n',strip=True)
        textp=base/'sources'/(t['economic_period']+'_全文.txt')
        textp.write_text(full,encoding='utf-8')
        meta=[{'name':m.get('name',''),'content':m.get('content','')} for m in soup.select('meta[name]')]
        is_challenge='Please enable JavaScript and refresh the page.' in full
        tables=soup.find_all('table')
        status='HTTP_NOT_OK' if r.status_code!=200 else ('BROWSER_CHECK_ONLY_NO_ORIGINAL_REPORT' if is_challenge else ('ORIGINAL_REPORT_CONTENT_CANDIDATE' if tables and '应收' in full and '利润' in full else 'UNKNOWN_CONTENT_NOT_COMPLETE_REPORT'))
        item.update(status=status,status_code=r.status_code,final_url=r.url,path=p.as_posix(),text_path=textp.as_posix(),bytes=len(r.content),sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest(),completed_at=now(),metadata=meta,leaf_tables=sum(not x.find('table') for x in tables),current_content_title=soup.find('h1').get_text(' ',strip=True) if soup.find('h1') else (soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True) if soup.title else 'UNKNOWN'))
    except Exception as e:
        item.update(status='GET_FAILED_NO_RETRY',error_type=type(e).__name__,error=str(e),completed_at=now())
    trace({'event':'REQUEST_FINISHED',**item})
    return item
reports=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
    jobs={pool.submit(fetch,t):t['economic_period'] for t in eligible}
    for future in as_completed(jobs):
        reports.append(future.result())
        n=len(reports)
        if n%5==0 or n==len(eligible):
            print(f'原利润报告已读 {n}/{len(eligible)}；完整正文候选 {sum(x["status"]=="ORIGINAL_REPORT_CONTENT_CANDIDATE" for x in reports)}；不重试',flush=True)
reports.sort(key=lambda x:x['economic_period'])
dump('全部实际原报告取得回执_缺失保留.json',{'at':now(),'original_target_count':79,'actual_report_GETs':len(reports),'attempts':reports,'unlocated_targets':[r for r in loc if r['locator_status']!='EXACTLY_ONE_ORIGINAL'],'no_retry':True,'no_new_labels':True})
summary={'at':now(),'original_target_count':79,'catalog_raw_GETs':66,'catalog_HTTP_200_count':sum(r.get('status_code')==200 for r in receipts),'qualified_new_catalog_count':sum(r['content_status']=='ORIGINAL_CATALOG_WITH_ARTICLES' for r in catalog_semantics),'catalog_browser_check_only':sum(r['content_status']=='BROWSER_CHECK_ONLY_NO_ORIGINAL_CATALOG' for r in catalog_semantics),'catalog_raw_failures':sum(r['content_status']=='RAW_GET_FAILED_NO_RETRY' for r in catalog_semantics),'exact_original_report_locators':len(eligible),'unlocated_economic_periods':79-len(eligible),'report_raw_GETs':len(reports),'report_full_content_candidates':sum(r['status']=='ORIGINAL_REPORT_CONTENT_CANDIDATE' for r in reports),'report_unknown_or_failed':[{'economic_period':r['economic_period'],'status':r['status']} for r in reports if r['status']!='ORIGINAL_REPORT_CONTENT_CANDIDATE'],'raw_GET_retries':0,'new_linear_regressions':0,'new_simple_weighted_scores':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'full_financial_source_gate':'NOT_PASSED_FULL_79_NOT_AVAILABLE','financial_status':'NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN','goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET'}
dump('原目录与实际报告读取阶段结果.json',summary)
print(json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),flush=True)
